threshold: Mapped DNR parking asset within 100 meters of a DNR named recreation trail reference, plus independently named park access on official map or park guide. Not independently ground-checked.

points.title: Lake of the Clouds overlook parking
points.summary: DNR parking asset near the official Escarpment/North Mirror Lake trail reference at the end of M-107. Overlook walkway is separate from the strenuous ridge trail.
points.visitorAdvice: DNR recommends leaving campers and trailers at the middle ski-hill parking area during busy summer and fall visits; that trailer lot is not identified precisely enough here for turn-by-turn navigation.
points.coordinatesPurpose: DNR mapped parking asset; no claim of vacancy, open gate, plowed lot, or precise pedestrian entrance

points.title: Summit Peak approach parking
points.summary: Parking asset matched to the DNR Summit Peak Tower Trail reference. The official approach is about a half mile, followed by tower stairs.
points.visitorAdvice: DNR recommends leaving trailers/campers at the designated lot near the South Boundary Road turn-off, not at the upper turnaround. The lower trailer lot has not been individually verified.
points.coordinatesPurpose: DNR mapped parking asset; no claim of vacancy, open gate, plowed lot, or precise pedestrian entrance

points.title: Presque Isle River trail-area parking
points.summary: Parking asset matched to the DNR East and West River Trails reference. The river corridor has multiple lots and different steps, paths and platforms.
points.visitorAdvice: This matched lot is NOT a verified specific starting point for every waterfall. DNR identifies the trail behind the Presque Isle contact booth as the shortest approach to Nawadaha; follow on-site signs. No swimming or wading.
points.coordinatesPurpose: DNR mapped parking asset; no claim of vacancy, open gate, plowed lot, or precise pedestrian entrance

points.title: Pinkerton Trailhead parking
points.summary: Parking asset matched closely to the DNR Pinkerton Trail named reference. This is a wilderness trailhead, not a quick scenic overlook.
points.visitorAdvice: Road access changes seasonally. Hiking toward Lake Superior requires independent trail, crossing and return-route planning.
points.coordinatesPurpose: DNR mapped parking asset; no claim of vacancy, open gate, plowed lot, or precise pedestrian entrance

points.title: Visitor Center Nature Trail parking
points.summary: Parking asset matched to the DNR Visitor Center Nature Trail record. This is distinct from the park-wide headquarters address.
points.visitorAdvice: The visitor center has seasonal hours. A mapped parking asset does not establish the building or parking is open on your date.
points.coordinatesPurpose: DNR mapped parking asset; no claim of vacancy, open gate, plowed lot, or precise pedestrian entrance

points.title: Winter sports trail-area parking
points.summary: Parking asset matched to DNR's named winter-sports trail network reference; use the eastern park approach in winter.
points.visitorAdvice: Confirm winter sports complex operations and snow reports. This parking-asset point does not guarantee access to the chalet, lift, or groomed trails.
points.coordinatesPurpose: DNR mapped parking asset; no claim of vacancy, open gate, plowed lot, or precise pedestrian entrance
